national_news.title: US Proposes Fresh Tariffs on 14 Economies Including India
bullets: The US Trade Representative (USTR) Jamieson Greer proposed fresh tariffs ranging between 15% and 35% on imports from 14 economies, including India, China, and the European Union.
For India, proposed tariffs under Section 301 reach up to 25%, with the potential for reduction to 17% if a reciprocal trade agreement is finalized.
The US administration invited public comments on the proposed measures until January 5, with formal hearings set to begin on January 25.

national_news.title: India Wins Best National Pavilion – Visitors’ Lion Award at Venice Art Biennale
bullets: India won the 'Best National Pavilion – Visitors’ Lion' award at the Venice Art Biennale, determined via global public voting.
The India Pavilion, located at the historic Arsenale, was commissioned by the National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA) under the Ministry of Culture.
The Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA) acted as the executing agency for setting up the pavilion.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights 'Kartavya' and Constitutional Values on Constitution Day
bullets: PM Narendra Modi authored a Constitution Day op-ed emphasizing 'Kartavya' (duty of citizens) to build a developed India by 2047.
Cited a recent World Bank report stating nearly 50 crore Indians have moved out of poverty due to targeted government schemes and digital platforms like UPI.
Highlighted that the 2019 abrogation of Articles 370 and 35A enabled the full implementation of the Indian Constitution in Jammu and Kashmir.

national_news.title: Nation Observes Constitution Day on 26th November
bullets: India observed Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) on November 26, marking the 1949 adoption of the Constitution by the Constituent Assembly (formally celebrated annually since 2015).
The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs facilitated an online reading of the Preamble via the MyGov portal in 23 languages (22 Scheduled Languages and English).
Various nationwide events, seminars, and digital outreach campaigns were organized across central ministries, states, and UTs to promote constitutional awareness.

national_news.title: WAVES Film Bazaar at IFFI in Goa Highlights India-Chile Co-productions
bullets: The 20th edition of the WAVES Film Bazaar at IFFI in Goa drew 2,288 delegates from 54 countries, including 471 buyers.
Key outcomes featured two Letters of Intent for India-Chile co-productions alongside 14 MOUs nearing finalisation.
The event was organized under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting and facilitated around 220 business-to-business meetings.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Chairs 55th PRAGATI Meeting Reviewing Infrastructure and ITI Ecosystem
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the 55th PRAGATI meeting, reviewing five infrastructure projects in road, power, coal, and railway sectors worth over ₹78,000 crore.
The meeting reviewed the ITI ecosystem and the implementation of PM-SETU (Pradhan Manti Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs).
The Prime Minister advocated the '3C approach' of Classroom-Company-Career to connect vocational training directly with industrial and employment needs.

national_news.title: 42nd National Good Governance Webinar Held by DARPG
bullets: The Department of Administrative Reforms & Public Grievances (DARPG) hosted the 42nd National Good Governance Webinar on November 26.
The webinar focused on the sustainability and replication of initiatives awarded under the Prime Minister's Awards for Excellence in Public Administration (PMA) 2024.
District officials from Koraput and Ganjam presented best practices in public administration to over 325 locations across India.

national_news.title: IndiaAI Mission Launches Indigenous Chariot-1 Foundation Models
bullets: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) Secretary S Krishnan launched the indigenous Chariot-1 foundation models under the IndiaAI Mission on November 26, 2026.
Developed by Chariot Artificial Intelligence Private Limited, the suite includes an 11-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Model (LLM) and a Text-to-Speech (TTS) model.
The TTS model supports English and 10 Indian languages (Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Punjabi, and Odia), achieving over 97 per cent verbalisation accuracy.

The models feature key research innovations such as IndicShift (shared alphabet for Indian scripts), Nested Training, and Mixture of Vocabularies to enhance training efficiency and multilingual performance.

national_news.title: Union Health Ministry Observes Constitution Day with Collective Reading of Preamble
bullets: The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare observed Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) on November 26, 2026, at Kartavya Bhawan in New Delhi.
Senior officials, along with representatives from bodies like NACO, NHA, and NMC, participated in the collective reading of the Preamble to reaffirm their commitment to constitutional values.
Constitution Day commemorates the adoption of the Constitution of India by the Constituent Assembly on November 26, 1949.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Doloo Greenfield Airport in Assam and Second Container Terminal at Kamarajar Port
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved the development of a new Greenfield Airport at Doloo, Silchar, Assam at an estimated cost of ₹2,014 crore.

The new airport project in Cachar district features a 12,351 sqm terminal building with a capacity to handle 800 peak-hour passengers and 1 million passengers annually, along with a Code-4C-compliant runway for A320 aircraft.
The Union Cabinet also approved over ₹4,000 crore (₹4,288 crore) for the development of the Second Container Terminal at Kamarajar Port Limited in Tamil Nadu to expand port capacity and boost trade.

national_news.title: US Proposes Tariffs of up to 25% on Imports from India
bullets: The United States Trade Representative (USTR) has proposed fresh tariffs ranging from 15 to 35 percent on imports from 14 economies, including India.
For India, tariffs of up to 25 percent have been proposed (accounting for existing Section 301 duties), with a potential 17 percent rate if a reciprocal trade agreement is reached.
The proposed measures aim to address policies believed to disadvantage American manufacturers, with public comments invited until January 5 and hearings beginning January 25.

national_news.title: India Marks Constitution Day on November 26
bullets: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) is observed on November 26 to commemorate the adoption of the Indian Constitution by the Constituent Assembly in 1949.
The day has been observed annually since 2015 to promote constitutional values, responsible citizenship, and democratic awareness.
The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs facilitated an online reading of the Preamble via the MyGov portal in 23 languages (22 Scheduled Languages plus English).

national_news.title: Nationwide Initiatives Launched for Constitution Day Celebrations
bullets: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) was celebrated across the country on November 26, commemorating the 1949 adoption of the Indian Constitution.
The Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad was organized across 786 districts in 36 States and Union Territories from November 24 to 26 to foster youth engagement.
Special digital initiatives included an online Preamble reading in 23 languages and a nationwide Constitution Quiz on MyGov and MyBharat portals.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets One Crore Litres of Daily Milk Production by 2030
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary announced a target to increase daily milk production from 48 lakh litres to 1 crore litres by 2030.
The initiative aims to strengthen the rural economy, promote women's financial independence, and expand the Sudha cooperative network.
Plans include promoting goat rearing to collect 1 lakh litres of goat milk daily, establishing veterinary clinics in every block, and supporting organic manure and compressed biogas projects.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Plans to Integrate AI Across Public Healthcare Delivery System
bullets: Bihar is integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) across its public healthcare delivery system to cover medical diagnostics, telemedicine, and emergency response.
The roadmap includes AI-enabled analysis of X-rays, CT scans, and MRIs to detect diseases like tuberculosis and cancer early.
The state is also deploying digital hospital bed management systems and piloting AI-enabled smart ambulances equipped with digital ECG and GPS tracking.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Plans 31 New Medical Colleges to Double MBBS Seats to 10,000 by 2030
bullets: Bihar plans to establish 31 new medical colleges (15 brownfield and 16 greenfield) over the next three years using a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model.
The initiative aims to double the state's total MBBS seats from 5,000 to 10,000 by 2030 to serve its population of approximately 140 million.
The government also aims to establish at least one university in every district of Bihar within the next three to four years, having approved five new public and four private universities.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches First e-Cabinet System, Becomes 12th State
bullets: Bihar became the 12th Indian state to implement a paperless e-Cabinet system, launched on November 25, 2026, under Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary.
The first paperless meeting approved 34 proposals, including an administrative sanction of ₹1,794.32 crore for Patna's water supply covering 75 wards.

The National Informatics Centre (NIC) developed the platform, and ministers were provided iPads costing approximately ₹2 crore, expected to be recovered through paper savings within six to seven months.

bihar_news.title: Centre Considers Special Shares for Merged PFC-REC Entity
bullets: The Ministry of Power is considering issuing special 'superior voting rights' shares ('One Share, Ten Votes') and redeemable preference shares to retain a 51.75% stake and majority control in the merged PFC-REC entity.
The proposed structure aims to maintain government company classification while managing the post-merger dilution of the Centre's shareholding from 55.99% to 42.02%.
Fresh government investments for the arrangement are estimated between ₹7,500 to ₹8,000 crore, subject to independent valuation.

bihar_news.title: Rajgir Zoo and Nature Safari Win SKOCH Award
bullets: Bihar's Rajgir Zoo and Nature Safari won the prestigious SKOCH Award for sustainable eco-tourism and governance innovation.
Rajgir Zoo Safari (19.12 hectares) and Nature Safari (550 hectares) feature modern technology integrations like QR-code ticketing, real-time GPS vehicle tracking, and CCTV surveillance.
Eco-tourism visitors in Bihar increased from 55.20 lakh in 2022-23 to 74.90 lakh in 2024-25, according to the Environment, Forest and Climate Change Department.

bihar_news.title: BPSC Issues New Notification for Assistant Education Development Officer Recruitment
bullets: The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) released Advertisement No. 16/2026 for 935 Assistant Education Development Officer (AEDO) posts under the Education Department.
This new notification supersedes the previously published Advertisement No. 87/2025.
Online applications are scheduled to be accepted from December 1 to December 31, 2026.

bihar_news.title: National Milk Day 2026 Celebrated in Patna; BAHS 2026 Report Released
bullets: National Milk Day 2026 was celebrated in Patna, Bihar, alongside the release of the Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics (BAHS) 2026 report.

India's total milk production is estimated at 253.81 million tonnes for 2025-26, with Bihar's milk production increasing from 7.19 million metric tonnes in 2013-14 to 13.76 million metric tonnes in 2025-26.
The National Gopal Ratna Awards 2026 were conferred to recognize outstanding contributions to indigenous cattle and buffalo breed conservation and dairy development.
Key central schemes highlighted include the National Animal Disease Control Programme, Rashtriya Gokul Mission, and National Programme for Dairy Development.
